items.title: Why Did Vicor Stock Jump Before It Raised Its Outlook?
items.summary: Vicor (VICR) stock gained 21.2% in the week to Monday, Sep 21, while the S&P 500 rose 1.9%. The spark was a new license for its AI power technology. The company said what that license adds to its sales only after Monday's close, when it raised its revenue outlook. So the shares paid for the deal before Vicor put a number on it.

items.title: Valens Semiconductor and onsemi Partner to Develop Integrated 3MP Automotive Camera Sensor
items.summary: Valens Semiconductor (NYSE:VLN) has entered into a collaboration agreement with onsemi (NASDAQ:ON) to develop a cost-optimised image sensor incorporating MIPI A-PHY connectivity for high-volume automotive camera applications. The agreement, announced on 22 September 2026, focuses on integrating Valens’ connectivity technology directly into onsemi’s image sensors, targeting the 3-megapixel (3MP) segment.
